g.text: Business Domain Model - REVIEW (not ERD / JPA)
[start,end), local calendar days; immutable paid terms.
Root coverageEnd = end of ALL paid cycles.
Root may have zero cycles only while no successful purchase exists.
Cancellation preserves paid cycles, no refund.
recordedAt is DB business time inside ultimately committed tx.
Credit has no package consumption attribution.
Fee links one cycle; consumption links one effective cycle.
Caller + operation + request reference: at most one effect.
Full replay: monetary30days; cancellation7days; then tombstone.
No database keys/indexes/lock classes in this business model.
WAITING only automatic empty pool + consent, max24h.
